units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 34:12">Targ. Y. Num. XXXIV, 12</cite>.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 63a">B. Bath. 63ᵃ</cite> if he added in the agreement <he>אילין מֶצְרָנָהָא</he> (Alf. <he>מֶצְרָאנָהָא</he>) these are the fields adjacent to it. Ib. 128ᵃ <he>אפשר דמכוין מצרנהא</he> he may know exactly the estates contiguous to the field which he identifies.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 108b:15">B. Mets. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>הנהו ד׳ בני מֶצְרָנֵי וכ׳</he> those four neighbors of a field (entitled to preemption, v. <he>מִצְרָא</he> I).
